faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ravenshaw University Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for the Ravenshaw University Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment is 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 66 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position at Ravenshaw University through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Ravenshaw University Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs.1000/- per class with a maximum of Rs.60000/- for those with a Ph.D., and Rs.750/- per class with a maximum of Rs.45000/- for those without a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are as per UGC Guidelines, 2018, published in the Gazette of India, and its subsequent amendments.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position will be based on a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Ravenshaw University, which is www.ravenshawuniversity.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Ravenshaw University Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment is 3105.

faq.question: Q10. Which city and state is this job located in?
faq.answer: This government job is located in Kataka, Odisha, with the pincode 753003.
